## Scope
- Backlog/issue:
- Exec plan (if multi-step/risky):

## Contracts checked
- [ ] Architecture/domain docs
- [ ] API/mobile compatibility
- [ ] DB/schema governance
- [ ] Security/privacy/safety
- [ ] Analytics/observability

## Verification
- [ ] lint/typecheck/tests/build
- [ ] migration/constraint tests if data changed
- [ ] auth/abuse/concurrency tests if relevant
- [ ] visual/accessibility checks if UI changed
- [ ] rollout + rollback considered

## Risk
Describe failure mode, operational flag/kill switch and rollback.
